alg-frame.text: CHANNEL 4. SUBJECT: ONE PERSON AT A FORD. STATE: WAITING. THE FEED RECORDS. THE FEED DOES NOT ACT.

alg-redact.text: Some lines are covered. The cover lifts when the subject earns the right to read them.

alg-input.text: THE SUBJECT SPEAKS. THE FEED LOGS THE WORDS. THE WORDS GO ON THE SUBJECT'S FILE.

alg-roll.text: WHEN THE OUTCOME IS NOT CERTAIN, THE FEED ROLLS FOUR DICE. THE FEED DOES NOT CHOOSE THE RESULT.

handler-gate.text: Planning is free. Once you break the seal, the dice decide.

handler-fate.text: One Fate point, one favour. Spend it with care.

guide-4df.text: Roll four Fate dice. Each shows plus, minus or blank. Add your stat. Beat the number to win. Beat it by three for style.

fate-rule.text: A Fate point buys one thing you want. It is gone once spent.

gate.text: Planning is free: look, talk, change your mind. Execution is final. Once you break the seal, the dice decide.

lens.text: Old things show at the edge. You read each one as hymn or machine. Neither is wrong.

river-lore.text: The old road crosses the river at a ford. The ferrymen keep the stones and ask a small toll.
